preconditions.description: The number of words in the scroll is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.
Each word in the scroll has a length of at least 1.
The total length of all words in the scroll does not exceed 20000.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(word, str) and word.islower() for word in words)
preconditions.description: Each word consists of lowercase English letters.

postconditions.description: The result is either 0 (no valid way to recover the original scroll) or a non-negative integer modulo 10^9+7.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= i < n and 0 <= j < len(words[i]) for i in range(n) for j in range(len(words[i])) if candidate[i] == words[i][:j] + words[i][j+1:])
postconditions.description: For each candidate word in the valid sequence, it is formed by deleting exactly one character from the corresponding word in the scroll (or leaving it unchanged if no deletion is needed).

postconditions.expression: all(candidate[i] <= candidate[i+1] for i in range(n-1))
postconditions.description: The candidate sequence of words is in lexicographically non-decreasing order.

postconditions.expression: result == sum(1 for candidate in valid_candidates if all(candidate[i] <= candidate[i+1] for i in range(n-1))) % (10**9 + 7)
postconditions.description: The result is the count of all valid candidate sequences modulo 10^9+7, where each candidate sequence is formed by deleting at most one character from each word in the scroll (or leaving it unchanged) and the sequence is lexicographically non-decreasing.
